records.summary: SourcePlan is the neutral source artifact boundary; SourcePlanAssembly owns generated file assembly policy and configuration admission fragments before any host writes files.
records.rationale: Generators, fixture materialization and source edit planning share source text, file envelopes and contribution provenance. The semantic-runtime framework-registration code action already consumes this substrate.
guidance: Use SourcePlanAssembly for generated files and contributions under one source root. Keep app-builder lowering choices in AppBuilderSourcePlanAssembly and target-specific lowerers.

Aurelia framework-registration admission source supplies import and registration-expression requirements to the template diagnostic code-action owner. That owner computes edits from the current app. The host owns application of the plan.
Legacy source-lowering field flags and fixture guidance are archived in packages/atlas/memory/records/source-plan.json at d5305caef.
